methods.name: hybrid perturbation mean match (HPM-Match)
methods.summary: A semi-supervised learning framework that integrates input-level, feature-level, and model-level perturbations. It uses a dual-branch input perturbation (DIP) generation approach and an independent triple-stream perturbation (ITP) structure to enhance model accuracy with limited labels by maximizing the utilization of perturbation spaces and minimizing erroneous information during consistency learning.
methods.verbatim: we propose a novel and generic DL framework called hybrid perturbation mean match (HPM-Match).
